explanatory_strength.rationale: The upcycle mechanism is specific—800G datacenter demand plus CATV upgrades driving revenue and Taiwan capacity—but the packet does not test whether industry supply additions will erode incremental returns.

evidence_sufficiency.rationale: Company filings anchor revenue, capex, and concentration, yet marathon-required industry capacity, utilization, maintenance-versus-growth capital, and incremental ROIC are not measured.

downside_control.rationale: Q1 2026 cash of $439.7M helps, but two customers exceed 80% of revenue, shares rose from 60M to 76M, and reported FY2025 free cash flow was negative after $179M capex.

return_vs_alternatives.rationale: Normalized mid-cycle owner cash implies about -13% to -23% annual return at $99.77 across bear, base, and bull Lawrence paths, all below the 12% hurdle.

claims.claim: FY2025 revenue was $455.7M (+83% YoY) while capital spending was $179.1M, exceeding $174.4M operating cash flow and producing negative reported free cash flow.
Digicomm and Microsoft accounted for roughly 53% and 29% of FY2025 revenue; the top five customers were 95% of revenue.
At $99.77, contract mid-cycle component value is about $16.34 per share on normalized owner cash of $0.74 per share, implying roughly -23% annual return in the base capital-cycle build.

strongest_counter_explanation: The 800G datacenter upgrade is a multi-year structural shortage, not a cyclical peak; Taiwan capacity and vertical laser integration earn high incremental returns as hyperscaler sockets expand beyond the two dominant customers.
most_important_missing_fact: Industry-wide 800G optical transceiver capacity additions, fab utilization, and incremental returns on peer and customer-owned supply (Coherent, Lumentum, Innolight, and hyperscaler insourcing) needed to test supply-response risk.
falsifiers: Industry 800G capacity additions accelerate while AOI unit margins compress
Capital spending stays above $150M annually with free cash flow still negative after 2027
Digicomm or Microsoft revenue share falls without replacement hyperscaler volume
specialist_findings: Filings show classic late-upcycle capital deployment—revenue inflection, capex quadrupling, equity-funded Taiwan expansion, and extreme customer concentration—while the packet lacks industry supply data to distinguish structural scarcity from a reinvestment trap. Price embeds hyperscaler optionality far above mid-cycle normalized owner cash.
